\textbf{Informative-observation extension} (secondary, post hoc; MAP fits with Laplace 95\% intervals). (a) Observation rates of the 18 literature annotators under the true class and under the other classes at the best optimum of Family-HB + observation and EM + observation (global universe; dashed: equal rates, i.e. ignorable observation). The two models place most of their annotators on opposite sides of the diagonal (above it: 0 of 18 for Family-HB + observation, 18 of 18 for EM + observation): the label T is not anchored. (b) Mean credibility of unobserved, observed-but-unreported and reported edges for the ignorable models (EM, Family-HB) and the extensions (large markers: global universe; small open markers: immune, kidney and lung). In the global universe Family-HB + observation gives unobserved edges the highest mean credibility (0.97); EM + observation ranks them below observed-but-unreported edges (0.033 vs 0.56).
